description: A latching two-way signal switch: a trigger on one side passes that side's input to the output and holds it there until a trigger arrives on the other side

inputs.text: A trigger here selects In 1; the two Tr 1 jacks are added as magnitudes and fire when the total passes 2V, so a negative voltage triggers as readily as a positive one
A trigger here selects In 2; the two Tr 2 jacks are added as magnitudes and fire when the total passes 2V, so a negative voltage triggers as readily as a positive one
The signal passed to Out while In 1 is selected
The signal passed to Out while In 2 is selected

outputs.text: Carries whichever of In 1 and In 2 the last trigger selected

notes: the module comes up with In 1 selected and the choice is saved with the patch; the lit lamp under a column shows which input is being passed.
a trigger on Tr 1 and Tr 2 in the same frame leaves In 1 selected.
one voltage is passed through, not polyphonic channels, whatever the cable carries.
